data.name: Serpent's Tongue Gift
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks. Once per day when you succeed at a Bluff or Diplomacy check against a creature, you can attempt to influence it as if using suggestion with a caster level equal to your character level and a duration of %2 minutes.|HellboundSerpentsTongueBonus|TL
